posts.name: Samuel .V.C.
posts.cooked:
I have performed OPPE 1 poorly and am sure that I need OPPE 2, the issue is that I am looking to change devices, can I do a keygen in the new device as well with the same link or is there something additional that must be done?
@pds_staff @sayan Pls help

From the new device:

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: You can make new key and upload to se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in

posts.name: Rajat Goel
posts.cooked: @sayan Sir do we have to make any changes for 14th Dec OPPE, will my old keys work on that day. Please answer
posts.edit_reason: Automatically removed quote of whole previous post.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: You don’t need to make any new keys if your old keys are already uploaded

posts.name: Rajat Goel
posts.cooked: Uploaded where, i have just generated them, they are saved in my system. Am i missing something

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Yes, you are missing the most vital step Rajat.

Please read previous message for the link to upload.
